Filled out.

Excited for the prospect of a Switch version (prefer it to my phone as a portable gaming device), and glad to see the prospect of Story Mode is still hanging around.

I'd expect story mode would be a minimum requirement for a console release, so it gives the wider audience (re: the majority of people who have never played Sentinels) a chance to learn/understand the game without a demo or being walked through multiplayer by someone else.

But story mode alone would sell this game on a console for me.

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
Story mode would be a plus, but not enough for me to buy the game all over again.  I've already spent more money on it than on almost any other game I own (and I got it on sale).  I think there's probably a market for Switch, though--re-releases like Super Meat Boy have shown that people are plenty likely to buy even old games on it.  And Switch would allow touch controls.  I'd hate to try to play Sentinels with a gamepad.

Some of the questions were phrased a little oddly, as if the PS4, XBOne, and Switch were the only consoles in existence.  Clearly those are the only ones on the table for this, but it was still a bit weird having to claim that I own only one console.

posts.name: Lateralis
posts.cooked:
We are operating from the assumption that everyone wants story mode on the existing versions so there's no real reason to ask that :)

originally there was a question about story mode for owners on other platforms but we couldn't find a good way to word it. something like:

"if we did a kickstarter for console which included story mode, but you already own the game on steam or mobile and don't want to buy it again, would you kick into the kickstarter just to ensure story mode was created and therefore comes to all version of the game."

 

as you can see, it was a bit unweildy. there were like 3 if/then statements and we didn't want to muddy it up more than it already was.
